modules.name: Complaint Management
modules.description: Lets residents raise, track, approve and reopen complaints, with notifications to the Society Manager and the resident.

requirements.title: Raise complaint with photo
requirements.description: A resident can fill in a complaint and add a photo. The system creates a complaint number and notifies the Society Manager.

requirements.title: Track complaint status and timeline
requirements.description: When a resident opens a complaint, the system shows its status and timeline.

requirements.title: Notify resident when complaint is fixed
requirements.description: The resident gets a notification when the complaint is fixed. The system shows the fix remark and photo.

requirements.title: Resident approves fix to close complaint
requirements.description: When the resident taps Approve, the system closes the complaint and removes it from her list.

requirements.title: Reopen complaint with reason
requirements.description: If the resident is not satisfied with the fix, she can reopen the complaint and must give a reason.

requirements.title: Show rejection reason to resident
requirements.description: If a complaint is rejected as not genuine, the resident can see the reason for the rejection.
